biggest_catch: The $200 tier requires the friend to fund $5,000 of new money within 30 days and hold a $5,000 average daily balance for six consecutive months.
catches: Referrer and friend each earn $50 when the friend opens a new checking account and sets up $500 recurring monthly DD within 90 days.
Referrer and friend each earn an additional $200 when the friend funds $5,000 of new money within 30 days and maintains a $5,000 minimum average daily balance for six consecutive months.
There is no limit to the number of people an existing member can refer; the referred person can only receive one $50 and/or one $200 referral bonus.
Friend must be new to St. Mary's Bank (no primary/joint checking in the last 180 days) and 18+.
No bonus if any account is in default, closed, suspended, or otherwise not in good standing.
All bonuses reported to the IRS on a 1099-MISC.
Cannot be combined with any other offers outside of the refer-a-friend promotion.
Eligible accounts: Beyond Checking, 603 Account/Checking, Beyond Rewards Checking, Beyond Interest Checking; $10 minimum opening deposit.
